topic: Template Class Specialization and Type Traits for Compile-Time Predicate Negation
explanation: In modern C++, templates enable generic programming by allowing classes and functions to operate with types specified at compile time. Such techniques are essential for creating flexible, type-safe, and efficient code that adapts behavior based on type traits or compile-time conditions.
keywords: Template specialization, Type traits, Compile-time logic, C++ metaprogramming
